content: {"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-2-UI-SIGNIN-FORM", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-2", "type": "UI", "name": "SignInPage (account-access sign-in form)", "file_path": "frontend/src/features/auth/SignInPage.tsx", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Owned entry surface for sign-in: the 'Username or email', 'Password', and 'Sign in' control group on the account-access page; shows exactly the generic 'Invalid credentials' failure and stays on the page without creating a session when authentication fails.", "specification": "Controlled form with `identifier` (label 'Username or email', name/id `identifier`) and `password` (label 'Password'), submit button labelled 'Sign in', and the 'Create an account' link to /register. Submit calls the auth client `signIn({identifier, password})`; on failure (`ok:false`) it renders the single generic message via `role=\"alert\"` (never distinguishing unknown identifier, wrong password, or unavailable account) and does NOT invoke onSignedIn, so no session/account-menu appears. On success it calls `onSignedIn(account)` exactly once, which is the only path that updates global session state and the redirect to the workspace. Includes 'New to the product?' link routing to the registration page.", "inputs": ["props: { onSignedIn?: (account: AuthAccount) => void }", "user input: identifier string (username or email), password string"], "outputs": ["onSignedIn(AuthAccount) on success", "inline alert text 'Invalid credentials' on failure", "no navigation and no authenticated chrome on failure"], "callers": ["frontend/src/App.tsx route element for path '/login' (reused from REQ-1-1-1, wired here to setAccount + navigate('/workspace'))", "frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx 'Sign in' link to /login"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-2-API-AUTH-CLIENT (signIn)", "REQ-1-1-2-UI-SESSION-PROVIDER via App.tsx setAccount", "react-router-dom Link to /register"], "test_focus": ["Renders heading 'Sign in' plus both labelled fields and the 'Sign in' button", "Successful submit with alice-dev / alice.dev@example.test / Valid-password-123! triggers onSignedIn and no alert", "Wrong password, unknown identifier, and unavailable account each render exactly 'Invalid credentials' and never call onSignedIn"]}
callers: frontend/src/App.tsx route element for path '/login' (reused from REQ-1-1-1, wired here to setAccount + navigate('/workspace'))

content: {"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-2-UI-SESSION-PROVIDER", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-2", "type": "UI", "name": "SessionProvider / useAuthSession (global authenticated state)", "file_path": "frontend/src/features/auth/SessionProvider.tsx", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Single global source of truth for the current browser session: exposes the current account, a restore status, and the setters/refresh/signOut actions consumed by the account menu, protected routes, home page, and workspace.", "specification": "Context value `{ account: AuthAccount|null, status: 'loading'|'ready', setAccount, refresh, signOut }`. Mounted once above the route table. On mount it restores the durable session via fetchSession() (GET /api/auth/session) so a signed-in user survives refresh/reopen; `status` stays 'loading' until that first restore settles and becomes 'ready' afterwards, including on restore failure (account null). setAccount replaces the global account immediately after login/registration. signOut revokes the durable session and clears the account even when the revoke call fails. useAuthSession throws outside the provider so no surface keeps page-local user state.", "inputs": ["children: ReactNode", "session restore response from GET /api/auth/session"], "outputs": ["AuthSessionValue context consumed by all authenticated surfaces"], "callers": ["frontend/src/App.tsx (provider mount + setAccount after sign-in)", "frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx", "REQ-1-1-2-UI-ACCOUNT-MENU", "REQ-1-1-2-UI-PROTECTED-ROUTE", "REQ-1-1-2-UI-WORKSPACE-PAGE"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-2-API-AUTH-CLIENT (fetchSession, logout)"], "test_focus": ["status is 'loading' before the restore resolves", "account is restored from the session endpoint on mount (reload-safe current user)", "signOut clears account and leaves status 'ready'"]}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-2-UI-ACCOUNT-MENU", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-2", "type": "UI", "name": "AccountMenu (upper-right account chrome)", "file_path": "frontend/src/features/auth/AccountMenu.tsx", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Shared upper-right account menu that represents the frontend session: shows the current username from global session state and offers sign-out; renders nothing when unauthenticated.", "specification": "Reads useAuthSession(); returns null when `account` is null so unauthenticated pages (and failed sign-ins) show no account menu. When authenticated it renders a button labelled with `account.username` (data-testid 'account-menu-button', aria-haspopup='menu', aria-expanded reflecting open state) that toggles a panel (data-testid 'account-menu', role='menu') containing the account email and a 'Sign out' menu item calling the shared signOut then optional onSignedOut callback. No local user copy: all data comes from the shared session so it stays correct after refresh.", "inputs": ["props: { onSignedOut?: () => void }", "shared session state via useAuthSession()"], "outputs": ["username button and menu panel when authenticated", "null render when anonymous", "sign-out action on the shared session"], "callers": ["REQ-1-1-2-UI-WORKSPACE-PAGE header", "any authenticated shell/header surface added by later requirements"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-2-UI-SESSION-PROVIDER (useAuthSession)"], "test_focus": ["Renders the username after successful sign-in and after a session restore", "Renders nothing for an unauthenticated visitor or after a failed sign-in", "'Sign out' action returns the app to unauthenticated chrome"]}
callers: any authenticated shell/header surface added by later requirements

content: {"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-2-UI-PROTECTED-ROUTE", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-2", "type": "UI", "name": "ProtectedRoute (authorization gate)", "file_path": "frontend/src/features/auth/ProtectedRoute.tsx", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Guards authenticated pages such as the workspace: waits for the session restore, then either renders the protected children or redirects an unauthenticated visitor to the account-access page.", "specification": "Reads `{ account, status }` from useAuthSession(). While status === 'loading' it renders a loading placeholder (data-testid 'session-loading') so a valid cookie session is not mistaken for unauthenticated during restore. When status === 'ready' and account is null it renders <Navigate replace to='/login' state={{ from: location.pathname }} />. Otherwise it renders the children. Consuming the shared context (not a local flag) is what makes the previously accessible protected page still show the signed-in user after refresh/reopen, while a failed sign-in still requires authentication.", "inputs": ["props: { children: ReactNode }", "shared session state via useAuthSession()"], "outputs": ["children when authenticated", "loading placeholder during restore", "redirect to /login when unauthenticated"], "callers": ["frontend/src/App.tsx route element for '/workspace'"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-2-UI-SESSION-PROVIDER (useAuthSession)", "react-router-dom Navigate/useLocation"], "test_focus": ["Anonymous access to a protected path redirects to the sign-in page", "Directly reopening the protected path with a restored session renders the page and the current username", "Loading state is shown until the restore settles"]}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-2-UI-WORKSPACE-PAGE", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-2", "type": "UI", "name": "WorkspacePage (post sign-in destination)", "file_path": "frontend/src/features/workspace/WorkspacePage.tsx", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Thin destination reached after successful authentication: renders the workspace shell, the shared account chrome, and the current signed-in user, and states explicitly that organization/repository/work-item collections are provided by their own features.", "specification": "Renders a header ('GitHub Workspace') plus <AccountMenu /> and a main region with a heading. Reads useAuthSession(): 'loading' renders a loading state (data-testid 'workspace-loading'); authenticated renders 'Signed in as <username>' (data-testid 'workspace-current-user'); otherwise renders an alert-style message that sign-in is required (defensive only, since the route is gated). Renders no invented organization/repository/work-item rows: the collections section shows an explicit empty/not-yet-loaded state (data-testid 'workspace-collections-empty') and must not be replaced with hardcoded sample data; later features may load the real authorized collections through their own interfaces.", "inputs": ["props: { title?: string }", "shared session state via useAuthSession()"], "outputs": ["authenticated workspace shell with current username", "explicit loading/empty states instead of fake records"], "callers": ["frontend/src/App.tsx route (wrapped in REQ-1-1-2-UI-PROTECTED-ROUTE)"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-2-UI-SESSION-PROVIDER (useAuthSession)", "REQ-1-1-2-UI-ACCOUNT-MENU"], "test_focus": ["After sign-in the workspace shows the account menu with the username", "After refresh the same page still shows the signed-in user", "No hardcoded organization/repository/work-item rows are rendered"]}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-2-API-AUTH-CLIENT", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-2", "type": "API", "name": "authApi (sign-in, session restore, sign-out client)", "file_path": "frontend/src/api/authApi.ts", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Frontend HTTP boundary for account access: submits credentials, restores the durable session, and revokes it; normalizes failures into the generic sign-in result the page renders.", "specification": "Uses the shared axios instance from ./index (baseURL '/api', withCredentials true, global error interceptor). `signIn({identifier, password}): Promise<{ok, account?, error?}>` POSTs /auth/login and returns the account on 200; on any error it returns { ok: false, error } where the message falls back to the generic 'Invalid credentials' (the API's 401 body is `{ error }` and the interceptor copies it onto error.message). `fetchSession(): Promise<AuthAccount|null>` GETs /auth/session and returns `data.account ?? null`. `logout()` POSTs /auth/logout. AuthAccount = { id, username, email, emailVerified }.", "inputs": ["SignInInput { identifier: string; password: string }", "session cookie managed by the browser (withCredentials)"], "outputs": ["SignInResult { ok: boolean; account?: AuthAccount; error?: string }", "AuthAccount | null from fetchSession", "void from logout"], "callers": ["REQ-1-1-2-UI-SIGNIN-FORM", "REQ-1-1-2-UI-SESSION-PROVIDER (fetchSession, logout)"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-2-API-AUTH-ROUTES (/api/auth/login, /api/auth/session, /api/auth/logout)", "frontend/src/api/index.ts interceptors"], "test_focus": ["Successful sign-in resolves ok with the account payload", "401 response resolves ok:false with the generic message and no account", "fetchSession resolves null for an anonymous browser"]}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-2-API-AUTH-ROUTES", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-2", "type": "API", "name": "Auth HTTP routes (login, session, logout)", "file_path": "backend/src/routes/auth_routes.js", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Thin HTTP boundary mounted at /api/auth: shapes sign-in/session/logout requests and responses and owns the session cookie transport.", "specification": "POST /api/auth/login -> 200 { account } with Set-Cookie `session_token=<token>; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=<SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS>` on success, or 401 { error: 'Invalid credentials' } for unknown identifier, wrong password, or unavailable account (identical body for all three). GET /api/auth/session -> 200 { account: Account|null } resolved from the cookie token via the service (refresh-safe restore). POST /api/auth/logout -> 200 { ok: true } and clears the cookie. Never returns password material or a differentiated failure reason. When protected domain routes need the request's current account they must use the shared resolver instead of re-parsing cookies; keep the cookie name sourced from the shared session-context constant so client, route, and service stay consistent.", "inputs": ["JSON body { identifier, password } for login", "Cookie header containing session_token"], "outputs": ["200 { account } + session cookie", "401 { error: 'Invalid credentials' }", "200 { account: Account|null }", "200 { ok: true } + cleared cookie"], "callers": ["backend/src/index.js (app.use('/api/auth', createAuthRouter()))", "REQ-1-1-2-API-AUTH-CLIENT"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-2-FUNC-AUTH-SERVICE (signIn, getSessionAccount, signOut)", "REQ-1-1-2-FUNC-SESSION-CONTEXT (shared cookie/session constant)"], "test_focus": ["Valid credentials return 200 with the account and a session cookie", "Each of unknown identifier, wrong password, and unavailable account returns the identical 401 body 'Invalid credentials'", "GET /session with the issued cookie returns the account; without it returns null", "No session cookie is set on a failed login"]}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-2-FUNC-AUTH-SERVICE", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-2", "type": "FUNC", "name": "authService.signIn / getSessionAccount / signOut", "file_path": "backend/src/services/auth_service.js", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Owns credential lookup, availability check, uniform generic failure reporting, and durable session persistence (unique identifier + account identifier + active status).", "specification": "`signIn({identifier, password})`: normalizes the identifier (trim + lowercase) and looks it up against `accounts.username` or `accounts.email`; returns { ok: false, message: 'Invalid credentials' } for a missing identifier/password, an unknown account, a wrong password (constant-time-ish comparison through verifyPassword), and an unavailable/suspended account — the same message text is the only failure surface, so existence and which credential failed are never disclosed. On success it creates a cryptographically random session token (unique session identifier), inserts `{ token, account_id, active status, expires_at = now + SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS }`, and returns { ok: true, account, token }. `getSessionAccount(token)` joins sessions->accounts, rejects unknown, inactive, or expired sessions (deleting the expired row) and resolves the public account shape { id, username, email, emailVerified }, which is the single source for 'the current user' on protected requests. `signOut(token)` deletes the session row. `SIGN_IN_MESSAGES.invalidCredentials` must literally equal 'Invalid credentials'.", "inputs": ["{ identifier: string, password: string }", "session token string from the request cookie"], "outputs": ["{ ok: true, account, token } | { ok: false, message }", "public account { id, username, email, emailVerified } | null", "{ ok: true } from signOut"], "callers": ["REQ-1-1-2-API-AUTH-ROUTES", "REQ-1-1-2-FUNC-SESSION-CONTEXT"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-2-DB-SESSION-SCHEMA (accounts, sessions tables)", "backend/src/services/password.js (verifyPassword/hashPassword)"], "test_focus": ["Successful sign-in with the seeded alice-dev account persists a session row and returns the account", "Unknown identifier, wrong password, and suspended account all return the identical 'Invalid credentials' message and write no session row", "getSessionAccount returns the account for a live token and null for expired/inactive/unknown tokens"]}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-2-FUNC-SESSION-CONTEXT", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-2", "type": "FUNC", "name": "sessionContext (current user resolution for protected requests)", "file_path": "backend/src/services/session_context.js", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Single backend boundary that answers 'who is the current user for this request?' so protected organization/repository/work-item routes derive the current user from the login session instead of trusting request input.", "specification": "Exports SESSION_COOKIE_NAME ('session_token'), readSessionToken(req) (parses the raw Cookie header), resolveCurrentAccount(req) -> Promise<public account|null> delegating to authService.getSessionAccount (no duplication of session validation), and requireSession(req,res,next) which attaches req.currentAccount and responds 401 { error: 'Authentication required' } when no valid session exists, failing closed on missing/invalid/expired/inactive sessions. Protected feature routers must mount requireSession (or call resolveCurrentAccount) rather than re-implementing cookie or session parsing.", "inputs": ["Express request with Cookie header"], "outputs": ["public account for the request, or null", "401 { error: 'Authentication required' } from requireSession", "req.currentAccount attachment"], "callers": ["protected organization/repository/work-item routers added by later requirements", "REQ-1-1-2-API-AUTH-ROUTES for the shared cookie name"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-2-FUNC-AUTH-SERVICE (getSessionAccount)"], "test_focus": ["Returns the signed-in account for a request carrying a valid session cookie", "Returns null / 401 for absent, unknown, or expired cookies", "Never leaks session internals into response bodies"]}
callers: protected organization/repository/work-item routers added by later requirements
REQ-1-1-2-API-AUTH-ROUTES for the shared cookie name

content: {"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-2-DB-SESSION-SCHEMA", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-2", "type": "DB", "name": "accounts / sessions schema (session identifier, account identifier, active status)", "file_path": "backend/src/database/init_db.js", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Owns the durable schema behind sign-in: the account credential/availability record and the session record persisted after successful authentication.", "specification": "Created idempotently (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS) during `initializeDatabase()` on normal app startup. `accounts(id PK, username UNIQUE, email UNIQUE, password_hash, email_verified, ...)` holds the credential digest used by sign-in; add an explicit availability flag (e.g. `suspended INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`) so an unavailable account can be rejected — and must be rejected with the same generic 'Invalid credentials' as an unknown one. `sessions(token TEXT PK, account_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, created_at, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)` is the session record with a unique session identifier, the owning account identifier, and an active status (e.g. `active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1` plus index on account_id) consumed by getSessionAccount. Schema evolution must stay centralized in this file and be idempotent for already-created database files (guarded ADD COLUMN or equivalent migration), never duplicated in feature folders.", "inputs": ["startup call initializeDatabase() from backend/src/index.js", "environment database file selection (ARC_DB_FILE / DATABASE_FILE)"], "outputs": ["accounts and sessions tables with indexes ready for sign-in/session queries"], "callers": ["REQ-1-1-2-FUNC-AUTH-SERVICE", "REQ-1-1-2-DB-SEED-ACCOUNTS", "backend/src/database/test_harness.js"], "callees": [], "test_focus": ["initializeDatabase is idempotent across repeated startups with an existing DB file", "sessions rows carry token, account_id, active flag, and a future expires_at after sign-in", "accounts uniqueness on username and email is enforced"]}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-2-DB-SEED-ACCOUNTS", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-2", "type": "DB", "name": "Deterministic pre-existing account seed (alice-dev)", "file_path": "backend/src/database/seed_db.js", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Provides the GIVEN pre-existing, verified, available account as ordinary product data reachable through the normal startup path, not as a test-only fixture.", "specification": "seedDatabase() runs `INSERT OR IGNORE` for the deterministic account { username: 'alice-dev', email: 'alice.dev@example.test', password: 'Valid-password-123!' } with a fixed salt and `email_verified = 1`, inside a transaction, so repeated runs (app start, test DB setup, E2E preparation) change nothing. It is invoked by backend/src/index.js after initializeDatabase() so the account exists for a fresh runtime database and is sign-in capable through the real UI -> API -> service -> DB path. Seed data stays limited to genuine product preconditions; no scenario-time credentials or evaluator-specific fixtures may be added.", "inputs": ["withTransaction / run from backend/src/database/db_runtime.js", "hashPassword from backend/src/services/password.js"], "outputs": ["one alice-dev account row (idempotent) usable for sign-in"], "callers": ["backend/src/index.js startup (start())", "backend/src/database/test_harness.js for isolated test DB preparation"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-2-DB-SESSION-SCHEMA"], "test_focus": ["After startup, signing in with alice-dev / alice.dev@example.test and Valid-password-123! succeeds", "Running the seed twice does not create duplicate accounts", "The seeded account is verified and available so it is not rejected as unavailable"]}
callers: backend/src/database/test_harness.js for isolated test DB preparation
